This role will help Deel expand its global talent pool and facilitate the movement of employees across multiple regions. Give expert advice on immigration laws within EMEA countries ensuring client’s compliance with current regulations. Provide consultations (via email or call) to clients clearly outlining applicable immigration/work authorisation routes. Assess right-to-work requirements for Employee of Records (EORs) and other types of permits. Liaise with internal teams for corporate document gathering and work closely with other internal departments to ensure efficient case management. Show strong understanding of country specific immigration processes, compliance requirements and act as a subject matter expert for assigned countries/regions.
